flags.description: The player agreed to search for the missing caravan.
The player has read the patrol report.

nodes.speaker: captain_reyes
nodes.text: You there. You look like someone who can handle a sword. A supply caravan vanished on the north road two nights ago.

nodes.speaker: captain_reyes
nodes.text: My soldiers are stretched thin. Will you find out what happened to it?

nodes.speaker: captain_reyes
nodes.text: Good. Ask me anything you need before you leave.

nodes.speaker: captain_reyes
nodes.text: Then at least hear me out. Someone in this town might care, even if you don't.

nodes.speaker: captain_reyes
nodes.text: What do you want to know?

choices.text: Can I see the patrol report?
The report is signed by a scout I don't recognize. Who is she?
Fine. I'll take the job after all.

nodes.speaker: captain_reyes
nodes.text: Grain, mostly. And a locked chest from the capital that nobody will tell me about.

nodes.speaker: captain_reyes
nodes.text: Here. Wagon tracks leave the road near the old mill, then stop. No bodies, no blood.

nodes.speaker: captain_reyes
nodes.text: Ilsa Varn. She joined the patrol last month. I haven't seen her since she filed that report.

nodes.speaker: captain_reyes
nodes.text: Start at the old mill. And watch your back.

nodes.speaker: captain_reyes
nodes.text: Suit yourself. The road won't get any safer on its own.
